name: Amendments by the committee responsible – separate and split votes
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council establishing the Temporary Decarbonisation Fund
part_text: 2. The Fund shall provide financial support in the period 2027-2029 to address the remaining risk of carbon leakage associated with carbon intensive goods produced and exported by eligible operators of installations and eligible downstream operators in the period 2026-2027.
